observations.item: Project advisory pages (GitHub) for libexpat, zlib, lz4, zstd
observations.finding: Each page reported no published security advisories at fetch time (2026-10-06).

Security patch release. Owner reading: one High (CVE-2026-84782, DTLS retransmission buffer) and twelve Low (QUIC, X.509 extension caching, non-NIST EC curves, SM2, SSL_set_SSL_CTX, CMP, DTLS AEAD). A machine summary of the same page listed the X.509 extension-cache use-after-free (CVE-2026-84783) as Moderate and twelve Low; the page itself is authoritative. None of the listed titles concerns EVP_Digest*, SHA-1/SHA-2/SHA-3.
observations.disposition: API-scoped acceptance of 3.6.4: mmxisf uses only EVP_Digest, EVP_DigestInit_ex/Update/Final_ex with EVP_sha1, EVP_sha256, EVP_sha512, EVP_sha3_256 and EVP_sha3_512 (src/reader.cpp, src/writer.cpp checksum paths) and no TLS, DTLS, QUIC, CMP, CMS, X.509, EC or SM2 code.

observations.finding: Security patch release already contained in the pinned version; the reviewed titles likewise concern QUIC, CMS, CMP, DTLS, RPK and EVP_Cipher AEAD paths, none of which mmxisf calls (EVP_Cipher is not used).

The Expat changelog and release page identify 2.8.5 as a security release fixing CVE-2026-93990 (UTF-16 decoding: high surrogate without a low surrogate accepted; a changelog summary rated it CVSS 9.8). It postdates the pinned 2.8.4 and the v0.1.0-rc.1 review, and Dependabot has an open branch for the bump (dependabot/vcpkg/expat-2.8.5). Expat parses untrusted XISF headers in mmxisf, so this is directly relevant.
observations.sourceScopeReading: src/reader.cpp creates the parser with XML_ParserCreateNS("UTF-8", ...), which overrides any declared document encoding, and its XML-declaration handler rejects declarations whose encoding is not UTF-8. Expat's UTF-16 decoder therefore appears unreachable from the document encoding. This is a source reading, not a regression test or verified disposition, and the CVE text itself was not read in full.
observations.ownerDecisionNeeded: Accept Expat 2.8.4 for v0.1.0 with a dated API-scoped disposition (ideally backed by a test that a UTF-16 or BOM-prefixed document is rejected), or move the vcpkg pin to 2.8.5, which changes vcpkg.json and requires a new candidate rc.3 and a full rerun.

limitations: The review is not a gate pass until the owner disposes of Expat 2.8.5.
A project page showing no published advisory does not prove that no unpublished or newly disclosed vulnerability exists.
The review must be refreshed immediately before publication, including for the final commit Y.
The Windows runner image was inventoried but not re-audited for new advisories.
This record does not authorize publication.

owner.decision: Accept OpenSSL 3.6.4 for v0.1.0 with an API-scoped disposition; schedule an OpenSSL bump for the next mmxisf version.

nativeWindowsBuildEnvironment.disposition: The release is source-only: no Windows binaries, PDB files, compilers or runner components are distributed. The rc.1 disposition of CVE-2026-69522 (Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native, not in the project dependency graph) is carried forward unchanged; a new advisory search of the 20260925 runner image was not performed, so no toolchain-vulnerability claim is made.
